headlines.text: On a Wednesday in 2022, back when the inaugural ROH World TV Title was crowned as Samoa Joe vs. Minoru Suzuki went to war, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.74 ? a well-worked match. A dream match between two legendary hard-hitters ? a chop-and-forearm war that had the crowd chanting in approval, ending with Joe capturing a title that had eluded him throughout his whole career.
Back on this day in 2024, AZM made their AEW debut against Toni Storm, appearing on Collision, rated 6.88.

That Wednesday in 2022, the AEW World Tag Team Titles was up for grabs as Jurassic Express vs. reDRagon went to war, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.45 ? a strong outing. Every title match carries a little extra weight, and this one was no exception.

secondaries.text: On this day in 2024, Andretti, Dante & Sydal kicked off their AEW journey as a team, appearing on Collision, rated 6.90.
On this day in 2022, Lee & Strickland touched down in AEW for the first time as a team, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.61 ? a strong outing.
That Saturday in 2024, Athena vs. Red Velvet went to battle over the ROH Women's World Title, appearing on Battle of the Belts, rated 6.73.
